summary: Inspected all six retained responsive screenshots and ran a fresh read-only Chrome probe at 375, 390, 768, 1024, 1280 and 1440 px. HTTP was 200, fonts were ready, there were no broken images or page errors, and document-level overflow was 1 px at 375 and 0 px at the other widths. The page-owned product and blog regions nevertheless remain materially displaced and their controls are clipped.
issues: RSP-HOME-01 (high, horizontal positioning/width): expected derived responsive page-owned sections and their controls to remain readable and operable inside each retained viewport; actual home-promotions, home-bundles and home-recommended begin at x=-598.5 px at 375, -591 px at 390, -402 px at 768, -274 px at 1024, -146 px at 1280 and -66 px at 1440. At 375 the product cards are 714 px wide and alternating cards expose only 16.2% and 34.7% of their width; at 768 they expose 43.7% and 62.2%; at 1024 the first card exposes 20.6%. Fix the responsive centering/track width so the section heading, cards and action links fit the derived viewport without off-canvas displacement.

RSP-HOME-02 (high, control visibility): expected visible page-owned links to be inside the viewport; actual fresh clipped-control counts are 49 at 375, 49 at 390, 47 at 768, 24 at 1024, 12 at 1280 and 8 at 1440. Product links and Do koszyka actions occur outside the viewport even though document-level overflow is suppressed, so the small scrollWidth values do not establish responsive health.

RSP-HOME-03 (medium, blog layout): expected the derived home-blog region to remain aligned within the viewport; actual wrapper left positions are -536.5 px at 375, -529 px at 390, -340 px at 768, -212 px at 1024, -84 px at 1280 and -4 px at 1440. Retained screenshots visibly crop the blog heading/cards at the affected widths. Fix the same fixed-canvas centering assumption for the blog region.
